title: feat/macos search prefill selection
body:
Currently when the search cmd is executed, search input remains empty even if text is actively selected in the terminal

Change:
Modified the start_search logic to check for an active selection, and if that exists, set the search state with that value. Also pre-fill only if the selection stays within one line

Note: I used an AI(codex) to help me navigate through the codebase.
